slot_change_request.reason: Bind previously unspecified native packet/config semantics without truncating any retained TKM operand/write fields; real clock/pin maps and reverse credits must be bound before adopting

write.header: payload[39:0]=address40; payload[55:40]=mask16; all other payload bits0
write.credit_adapter_required: Native bus has no packet_ready port. Replace prototype ready with explicit registered packet credits carried in idle CFG40 control words (proposal index63,v0,commit0). Size recipient storage/lease count and price actual credit round trip; no combinational ready crossing may be adopted.
write.completion_required: Native done/busy must include pending encoded writes until actual sink acknowledgements return; upstream w_ready acceptance alone must not claim completion.

delivery.unresolved: Native four545b packet mapping must separately preserve delivery valid and advance reservation events. Full-tag preservation/marker format requires explicit contract; no truncation/reinterpretation claim.
delivery.proposed_lossless_control: Keep all545packet bits unchanged on each valid delivery. Serialize four advance-reservation events in CFG40 idle-control records index62,v0,commit0,data[3:0]=reservation_bitmap; data[7:4]=write_credit_grant_count. No destination-bit reuse. Initial configuration occupies5words+commit while admission is closed; control records then sustain one bitmap/clock and concurrent write credits.
delivery.phasing_required: Add a priced DEL capture stage if needed so decoded reservation precedes delivery at the unit. Prove all production tag/payload streams, source credit leases and bounded storage. This is proposed semantics, not a claimed integrated adapter.

bench.scope: Standalone codec bit-exact roundtrip of all CFG151 operand bits and every address40/mask16/data512 write bit; conditional stalls

price.analytical_only: Two-flit writes add at least32cycles for syn_sel O32writes, config measured10cycles; predicted baseline~2921 before credit/bridge startup effects, not a throughput qualification. Measure actual native composition before accepting.

required_before_route: Register every command/credit boundary at actual pins
Bind CFG return-credit semantics and DEL reservation encoding
Bind assigned slot pins and clock entries
Run exact+mutants at source commit and actual fullshape native price gate

data_fields.3:0: DEL reservation bitmap (all native545 DEL payload bits preserved)
data_fields.7:4: whole-write lease grant count; one lease covers header+data

credit_completion.startup: After six configuration words and local reset release, publish initial grant8 with admission closed until consumed; serialize next configuration only after prior actual-sink-ACK completion. Credit events must not be dropped under config mux.
credit_completion.done: wait every admitted write acknowledged at real sink, including entries still in codec TX and native flight; never local w_rdy alone
credit_completion.bench: NATIVE_OUTPUT exact 16 O/R writes,256words with full40b carry/masks/negativezero + IDmutant; native credit64writes1024words + earlycompletionmutant
credit_completion.physical: Packer and source encoder/lease controller share one delivered own-flop root. Native control40 captured; internal ready never crosses hard boundary. Requires measuredCTS and actual price/clock/die binding.
